institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: R-ICE (rituximab/ifosfamide/carboplatin/etoposide) salvage

premedications.name: Mesna
premedications.notes: uroprotection with ifosfamide, matched to the ifosfamide dose

supportiveCare: G-CSF support (transplant-intent salvage - preserve stem-cell collection)
Plan stem-cell mobilization/collection after a chemosensitive response
monitoring: Response by PET before proceeding to high-dose therapy + autologous transplant

drugs.name: Ifosfamide
drugs.notes: 5000 mg/m2 by continuous IV infusion over 24 h on day 2, with mesna uroprotection.

drugs.name: Carboplatin
drugs.notes: AUC 5 (Calvert) IV day 2, capped at 800 mg.
